messages.author: 0ebb124842957335
messages.subject: feature request for featureCounts
parts:
Besides the mapped read count values for each sample, the output of Subread's featureCounts currently includes values for only the attribute that is specified by the 'g' option (gene_id by default; when summarization is done at meta-feature level). Thus, the output will not include the 'gene_name' attribute value even if it is there in the GTF (annotation) file.

It will be good if the featureCounts provides a way to optionally include values for other attributes that are there in the GTF file. E.g., having 'gene_name' values in the featureCounts output will be helpful and time-saving.

messages.author: 6569f7247d312021
messages.subject: Re: feature request for featureCounts
parts:
Thanks for the suggestion. It is on our to-do list.

At the moment, we use the Bioconductor annotation packages to convert gene ids to gene symbols. An advantage of doing this is that you can always get the latest official gene symbols. It is also quite straightforward to do this.

Cheers,
Wei
